sourceObserver: Allocation-free independent bit observer checks common framing, bounded ASCII text, all modeled legacy plot/layout scalar values including exact signed zero, bit/body boundary, typed roles, targets and terminal padding. Captured callback type 82 is normalized; the source bytes contain class 502, which the separate test joins to unique unchanged published LAYOUT/AcDbLayout class evidence.

validation.inputs: All eight ACadRust-generated R13/R14 null/bound original and producer-resaved controls passed the source observer; files stay in scratch and are correlated with ACadSharp lineage.
validation.mutations: For both generated profiles, captured source bytes are compared to the input file; changed model fields, typed reference roles/targets, physical handle-role bits and changed class evidence refuse; restoring each source passes. In-memory controls verify signed zero, full-width handle metadata, failure atomicity and same-observer retry.
validation.asan: The fully instrumented library and generated in-memory observer controls pass under AddressSanitizer.
validation.reproduction: Generate inputs with tools/research/generate_acadrust_legacy_shape.py; set LIBDXFRW_AC1012_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE and LIBDXFRW_AC1014_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE to corresponding scratch resaved DWGs when configuring tests; build libdxfrw_dwg_ac1014_output_external_tests and run the two external CTests.

limits: Observer and external control are bounded to no EED, ASCII strings, no viewport list and the tested callback profile; they do not qualify arbitrary legacy layouts.
Class binding uses the existing unchanged import evidence; the external test additionally matches retained raw bytes to the selected small source-frame offsets.

No native AutoCAD witness, dictionary merge semantics, complete source graph, target projection, emitted DXF physical-link proof or independent output readback is established. The export refusal remains in place.
